title: Count Special Subarrays with Frequency Constraints
description: Given an array `nums` and an integer `k`, count the number of subarrays where the most frequent element appears at least `k` times.
input_format: First line contains `n` and `k`. Second line contains `n` integers.
hints: Once a window [l, r] has max frequency >= k, all extending subarrays ending at r..n-1 are also valid.
Advance the left pointer and accumulate valid subarray counts.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n, k = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[2:2+n]]
    from collections import defaultdict
    pos = defaultdict(list)
    ans = 0
    l = 0
    counts = defaultdict(int)
    max_freq = 0
    for r in range(n):
        x = nums[r]
        counts[x] += 1
        if counts[x] > max_freq: max_freq = counts[x]
        while max_freq >= k:
            ans += (n - r)
            counts[nums[l]] -= 1
            l += 1
            max_freq = max(counts.values()) if counts else 0
    print(ans)
